reason: PURE. objection: $29.99 is double what I pay for my 12-in-1 in a flash sale, and I'm not sure single-form bisglycinate does more for me than my multi-form one.
would_change_my_mind: A first-box price around $20 or a flash-sale deal, or a smaller trial pack so I can test it on my trips before committing to 30 sachets.
